//: The DECLARED region-path ledger read by check-region-host-attribution.
C79 §6.3 enumerates every region-capable creation path in the tree and its
conformance status. This file is that table in machine-readable form. The gate
does NOT rediscover the table by heuristic — a heuristic that finds region paths
by grepping for the word 'region' would count comments, tombstones and this
very ledger. It reads the declared rows, RE-MEASURES each one against its own
source file, and reports disagreement in BOTH directions:
* a row declared CONFORMING whose file no longer emits attribution  → finding
* a row declared NON-CONFORMING whose file now emits attribution    → STALE
* a row declared CAPABILITY_ABSENT whose file has grown a region mode → STALE
C79 §8.2 / §8.1: 'A region gate that finds ZERO region paths has not passed —
it has failed to measure.' The floors below make a vanished subject exit 2.
STATUS VOCABULARY (C79 §6.3's own column, closed):
CONFORMING        the path emits host references (or, for a family whose data
model cannot store them, RETURNS + REPORTS the five §2.5
counts at its own boundary, which is what §6.1's second
limb — 'or state, in a form a caller can read, why it
cannot' — asks for).
NON_CONFORMING    the path produces coordinates only. §7 anti-pattern rows
(boundingWallIds: []) live here too.
CAPABILITY_ABSENT the family has no region mode at all. Cannot inherit a fix.
declaredFindings is NAMED and SHRINK-ONLY. Each entry is '<pathId>:<why>'.
Measured 2026-08-12 by this gate's own first run; every entry is a C79 §6.3 row
that is NOT conforming, and it leaves the ledger in the commit that fixes it.
